subs: Basically, I was born and raised in Glorious Church.
I don't know how, but here I am —
from the moment I opened my eyes.
I started at Glorious Church in 1998.
So I've been in this church for 28 years.
In the beginning, we met under an old house.
Back then, we kept moving from place to place.
We moved so many times.
Rain or shine, we carried the instruments.
When the Lord gave us the CAP building,
we were overjoyed.
I was so happy —
we no longer had to carry the instruments, even in the rain.
I first came to know Glorious Church when I heard the worship team
while I was walking near the CAP building.
And I decided to go upstairs to follow that sound
that led me here to Glorious Church.
What happened back then, what everyone talked about —
you'd never imagine the leaders would suddenly leave.
It was crippling...
it truly made us cry.
And I remember, before Bishop passed away,
he said he wanted the Lord to take him home
while praising, praying, and worshiping the Lord.
And I remember so vividly —
three consecutive Sundays,
the Lord poured out His presence in this place.
But the beautiful thing is,
I saw what the enemy did to this church.
It was broken, destroyed —
but I also witnessed
how God rebuilt it, how God restored this church.
For me, it's a big milestone,
because in the past, many said this church wouldn't last.
But I've seen how this church has stood,
because this is really the church of God.
Our lives changed.
Truly — from nothing, into blessing.
Before, we had absolutely nothing.
I just graduated as a nurse,
and recently I passed my board exam.
Now I am a registered nurse.
God has been faithful to me
by giving me a community that encouraged me to build relationships
with the people around me — and with God, of course.
Even when life is so hard,
through His Word,
I realize that through faith, I can do anything with God.
For me, these 30 years are
three decades of the Lord's goodness,
of the Lord's faithfulness.
For me, the 30th anniversary is a celebration of faithfulness.
This 30th anniversary represents a powerful testament
to God's enduring grace and miracles.
Be strong and courageous.
For the next 30 years, I pray Glorious Church will be an instrument
not just here in Baguio City,
but all throughout the world.
I pray that Glorious Church continues to inspire generations to come
and bring more people closer to God.
I pray that Glorious Church
will be the church that always shares the word of God,
shares the love of Christ,
and shares a light that shines so bright
for all the generations to see.
From glory to glory,
onward to the next 30 years.
